The '''Aethrorn Mountains''', sometimes known as the '''Aethrorns''', were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. The ruins of a [[Jagomir pirate base|pirate base]] were located in the Aethrorn Mountains.<ref name="OAA1" />
